description: Deterministic safety rules for major drug-drug interactions validated against the DDInter dataset in data_validation/ddinter_normalized.json.

rules.evidence_text: DDInter validated major interaction: Concomitant use of dolutegravir with polyvalent cation-containing antacids (such as aluminum hydroxide) significantly reduces dolutegravir absorption via chelation.
rules.action: stagger administration or evaluate alternative; polyvalent cation chelation impairs absorption

rules.evidence_text: DDInter validated major interaction: Clarithromycin is a potent CYP3A4 inhibitor that markedly increases simvastatin plasma concentrations, substantially increasing the risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis.
rules.action: suspend simvastatin therapy during macrolide course; CYP3A4 inhibition markedly increases rhabdomyolysis risk

rules.evidence_text: DDInter validated major interaction: Clarithromycin inhibits P-glycoprotein efflux transport, leading to significant elevation of serum digoxin levels and risk of digitalis toxicity.
rules.action: monitor serum digoxin levels closely and evaluate dose reduction; P-gp inhibition increases digitalis toxicity risk
